notes: Potrero Hill / lower Mission Bay edge (between 16th St and the streets south of it, sheet p09 of the 1968 map): ordinary rectangular grid. What the map shows here: every block is closed by its own thin line (about 4 px) with open street paper around it; zoning borders are heavier lines (about 7-10 px). Some run down the middle of streets (x 4290-4298 and x 4462-4475 and x 4640-4648 vertically; y 2201-2211 and y 2000-2008 horizontally), others cut through blocks (the M-1 stair through block 4305-4459 x 1806-1884; the two C-2 outlines at x 3892-3996 and x 4248-4340 crossing rows 5-9; x 4579-4588 and x 4605-4613 through the blocks of the 4475-4630 column; the stair at x 4402-4417 through block 4300-4453 x 2534-2614). Told apart by weight and by continuity: a block line closes on itself at the block's corners, a zoning border runs on across streets; corners were put on the outer edge of the block's own thin line, also where a heavy border runs over or next to it. Judgment calls: (1) Blocks 3958-4121 and 4123-4285 at y 1802-1883 are two printed blocks whose outlines nearly touch (1-2 px of paper at x 4122, no street between); typed as two blocks one px apart. (2) Blocks 4129-4284 x 2013-2196, 4303-4456 x 2015-2197 (M-1), 4477-4631 x 2015-2196 (P) and 4648-4803 x 2434-2615 are each one printed outline the height of two ordinary rows (no street through), so each is one block. (3) The C-M label box at x 4475-4628, y 2433-2510 is the block's own outline with the C-M letters inside; the heavier C-M district outline around it is a zoning border. (4) The left column's blocks run past the box's left side. Lettering is ignored.
